common.workload_seed_pairing: the exact same causal workload universe and fault probes are replayed across policies within each seed
common.slack_predictor: independent registered output distribution v1; does not read realized output or service and is not a physical GBDT calibration
common.copy_semantics: source-owned Peer-HBM and Store-DRAM copies are independent asynchronous queues; they do not add a serialized foreground transfer tail
common.capacity_semantics: weight + runtime reserve + active serving KV + physical-target Peer-HBM backup <= 40 GiB at every recorded event

topology_and_paths.placement: DP16 fills two 8-GPU nodes; even source ranks use same-node Peer-HBM/local DRAM and odd ranks use cross-node Peer-HBM/remote DRAM; v3.1.3 mapping is bijective

s4.purpose: single-factor mechanism ablation in a fixed high-information region; no win threshold

ablation_contract.Algorithm 1: zero only request slack metadata; keep controller, tiers, copy paths, capacity and AIMD
ablation_contract.Algorithm 2: keep Aegis controller, request slack, causal source copies, physical capacity and AIMD; replace independent per-tier SlackLandlord admission with coupled FCFS all-or-nothing direct-capacity admission
ablation_contract.Algorithm 3: keep request slack, independent tier admission and physical shared capacity; schedule identical control opportunities but execute no alpha update

s4.estimator: within each seed/domain, mean and p99 over the complete workflow x same-probe universe; paired t CI across the three seed-level policy/Full ratios
s4.primary_interpretation: worker/GPU failure is primary; source-node is always retained and reported, regardless of discrimination

s5.purpose: exercise AIMD under a fixed low-high-low offered-load schedule and persist physical occupancy/churn at every control window
s5.load_boundary_rule: an arrival exactly at a phase boundary belongs to the new phase and is processed before the control event at the same timestamp
recorded_fields: offered and realized active requests per GPU
alpha and alpha times 40-GiB target quota
shared serving-plus-backup budget kept distinct from policy quota
active serving HBM, physical-target Peer-HBM backup and Store DRAM bytes
per-window admit, reject, eviction, primary reclaim, AIMD release, resume and post-control dispatch deltas
event-integrated HBM and DRAM capacity byte-ms

behavior_gates.high_phase: each seed must observe pressure and an alpha decrease relative to the first low-phase control
behavior_gates.recovery_phase: each seed must observe at least one stable window and a later additive alpha increase
behavior_gates.failure_rule: if either behavior is absent, publish a FAIL diagnostic without changing phases, seeds or thresholds

hard_gates: all protocol source hashes match before execution
S4 uses the same workflow and probe tuple hashes across all five policies per seed
fault replay never lowers WCT and never changes the all-workflow denominator
Algorithm 2 ablation remains an Aegis controller and never maps to Static baseline
Algorithm 2 ablation never leaves a one-tier partial admission
Algorithm 3 ablation has identical scheduled windows and zero executed updates
copy admitted bytes equal scheduled bytes per tier
physical serving plus Peer-HBM backup never exceeds the frozen shared budget
S5 occupancy is sampled from event state and integrated bytes, never inferred from outcome/event fractions
S5 alpha quota is alpha times 40 GiB and remains distinct from serving reserve/shared budget
no seed, cell or window is selected by outcome direction
evidence_boundary: Three-seed preliminary DES only. Directional bandwidth, service, fence and replacement inputs are modeled/unmeasured; no physical A100 performance claim and no target-trend threshold.
